newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hokuetsu Bk to issue 29.82 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Hokuetsu Bk to issue 29.82 mln new shares.

text.p: Hokuetsu Bank Ltd said on Tuesday that it would allot about 29.82 million new shares to its shareholders at 255 yen per share in order to increase its capital.
The bank said in a statement that the Niigata-based regional bank expects to raise 7.6 billion yen through the new issue.
New shares will be allotted to investors who own Hokuetsu Bank shares at the end of January 31, 1997. The bank will allot 0.15 new share for every one share.
Applications for the new issues should be made between March 6-18, 1997, and the payment date is set for March 31, 1997, it said.
On Tuesday, Hokuetsu Bank's shares closed down one yen at 509 yen.
